title: Cap. X Arg. X cont.: if 1 Cor. iv. 7 holds of gratia gratis data, much more of justifying grace and of the first grace of election to life
pass_a_gloss: If this be true in grace freely given (as the School speaks), then much more in grace that makes acceptable, and most of all in that first grace of election unto life, which is the fountain and as it were the spring of all benefits conferring unto salvation.
pass_b_english: If that holds of gratia gratis data, as the School calls it, it holds much more of the grace that makes acceptable—and most of all of that first grace of election to life, the fountain and spring of every benefit that serves salvation.
source_text: Si hoc in gratia gratis data (ut Schola loquitur) verum sit, tum multo magis in gratia gratum faciente, et maxime omnium in prima illa gratia electionis ad vitam, quae fons est et quasi scaturigo beneficiorum omnium ad salutem conferentium.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. X Arg. X cont. section 754. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap10_arg10_densify.
